# Homepage of [Matthew R. Richardson](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-0977-2029)

> All content on the home.6t.lt subdomain is served from static assets on Cloudflare Workers.

## Main Links

- [HTML Blog](https://home.6t.lt/mf2.html): Uses 'h-feed' from microformats2.
- [HTML Sitemap](https://home.6t.lt/sitemap.html): List of files generated by a 'tree' command.
